description: Ally Financial is a leading digital financial service and began operations in 1919 as GMAC, a lending arm of General Motors. It then rebranded to its current name in 2010 in the wake of the financial crisis. Ally’s major divisions include dealer services, corporate finance, insurance, and digital banking. In early 2025, it began winding down its mortgage operations. Its dealer services segment is the nation’s largest bank auto finance operation, and overall Ally Bank is the largest all-digital bank in the U.S.

title: Ally Financial

rankings.title: 100 Best Large Workplaces for Women
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"For nearly 30 years, Ally has been my home away from home—supportive through many personal and professional milestones. Professionally, I have felt empowered to share insights that improve my team or the broader organization, treated fairly, and recognized for my contributions. Over time, my leaders and mentors have provided the guidance and trust needed to pursue a self-directed career path, while also offering the flexibility to maintain a healthy balance between my professional and personal life. What makes this organization truly distinctive is its demonstrated commitment to employees, the community, and customers—values that are actively lived, not just stated."

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Financial Services and Insurance
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say: 

"Relationships matter and carry beyond current responsibilities to previous roles—it is comforting knowing people to continue to care about others even when they aren't actively working on projects or workstreams anymore. I recently received a health diagnosis, as did my child, and the response from those I shared this with was and continues to be supportive; I've never been made to feel like this will in any way impact their assessment of me as a valued colleague or someone with less reliability. I know this doesn't seem like a big deal, but I've worked other places and heard from those I know how often this doesn't happen and how perception changes abruptly with these circumstances."

rankings.title: Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"The culture within our team and the company broadly is one that enables and encourages people to be themselves while also pushing themselves to be even better than they were yesterday. This is done in a reinforcing and supportive way rather than being pushed/forced on people. We lift others on our team up in a non-competitive way. Everyone is treated with respect and everyone's voice is able to be heard."

rankings.title: 100 Best Large Workplaces for Women
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"Ally truly cares about its employees and tries to find ways to help you when you have personal emergencies. Example: I was put on hospital bed rest a month before my twins were born. They were born 3 months early and had significant medical challenges. Ally not only made sure I kept my job in the midst of that life change, but that I had the resources I needed to get through it financially and emotionally. I will forever be grateful for the company I work for."

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Financial Services and Insurance
rankings.itemDescription:

"Ally is a uniquely great place to work because of its incredible workplace culture, where collaboration and innovation thrive. The support from both teammates and management fosters a positive and inclusive environment, making every challenge an opportunity for growth. With limitless opportunities to advance and continuously learn, Ally empowers employees to develop their skills and drive meaningful impact in their careers."

rankings.itemDescription: Employees say: "One of the things that is unique to Ally is its ownership mentality. Everyone here, regardless of level, are owners, and that makes a big difference in terms of the level of care each employee brings."

"It's important to me that I work for a place that supports local community and Ally does that. I feel proud to tell others I work there because they are a large part of the Charlotte community and support many different organizations."

rankings.title: Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For
rankings.itemDescription: Ally Financial, a financial services company with the country’s largest all-digital bank and an auto financing business, was not immune from inflationary forces in autos and struggles with electric vehicle sales, as it slashed 5% of its workforce in October. That followed the company raising its minimum wage to $23 in the fall of 2022, which was the second increase in the span of about a year. In January 2023, Ally began including pay ranges on job postings. In 2020, Ally launched its #OwnIt equity grant program, and it has now issued over 4 million shares to employees since its inception. Ally committed nearly $1 billion to affordable housing organizations in 2023, which includes investments, grants, and loans. Starting in 2021 and continuing through 2023, Ally gave $2 million in unrestricted grants and sponsorships to 16 minority-led nonprofits across Detroit and Charlotte through its Trust-Based Philanthropy program.

rankings.title: Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For
rankings.itemDescription:
The digital financial services company joins the Best Companies list for the first time in 2023.

  • In 2022, the Ally Charitable Foundation made a pledge of $5 million over five years to the Atrium Health Foundation to help support those from underrepresented backgrounds pursue careers in health care.

  • This past year, the company followed through on its commitment to provide access to capital for Black and Hispanic communities by granting $33 million in loans and investments to minority and women-led organizations, including the 22 Fund, BetaBoom, and Raza Development Fund.

  • Ally offers its workers eight hours of paid time off for volunteering each year, and in total employees gave more than 28,000 hours of volunteer work in 2022. Ally will also match up to $1,000 in personal donations from each employee to eligible non-profit.

  • 94% of employees feel good about the ways they “contribute to the community.”

  • In 2023, Ally expanded its mental health coverage. Now every employee, their dependents, and household members can access up to 16 free counseling sessions with a therapist per person annually, regardless of their enrollment in an Ally medical plan.

rankings.title: Fortune 500
rankings.itemDescription: Ally is one of the largest car finance companies in the U.S., providing financing and leasing for 4.5 million customers annually. The company also has an online bank, Ally Bank, and offers home loans and securities-brokerage and investment advisory services under the name Ally Invest. The stock has produced an average return of 16% over the past five years.
